propositions: Add an explicit opt-in read-only `rebar tracker-footprint` command that measures Git pack bytes, checkout logical bytes, checkout allocated bytes, and whole-clone totals separately without fixed thresholds or workflow gates

The command supports default mode (mounted tracker with shared object database detection) and `--fresh-clone` mode (temporary single-branch clone with hardlink optimization disabled for authoritative exclusive measurement)

Measurement output distinguishes packed object bytes; checkout logical/allocated bytes; Git-directory logical/allocated bytes; file count and allocation slack; and whole-clone logical/allocated bytes, with structured unavailable values for unsupported allocation accounting
Platform edge cases including missing `st_blocks` support and linked-worktree shared objects must be correctly identified and reported without fabricated values
Fresh-clone failures must exit nonzero and clean up only command-owned temporary state without mutating source refs or remote state
JSON output validates against schema and text/JSON rendering never emit threshold verdicts, pass/fail classifications, or size-based exit codes
